svg.title: India nearly caught the US. Then the gap widened.
svg.desc: The 100% line means equal public-push counts. Colored lines mark GitHub Copilot (21 June 2022), Cursor Agent (24 November 2024), and the Codex research preview (16 May 2025). Launch dates are not adoption dates or evidence of an AI effect. India’s count still rose after the 98% peak, but the US count rose faster.
svg.metadata: Data: GitHub Innovation Graph (CC0), https://github.com/github/innovationgraph/tree/078fb62ee4395d321bec9f4f06694cca68f6b6cb/data. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain); DataMeet India, CC BY 4.0, adapted. Full linked attribution accompanies each map in the gallery and notes.
